name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods: tool and connector switches, prompt-cache, usage and context meters, a mod manager, and looks for the desktop app

plugins.name: tool-toggle
plugins.description: Turn connectors, MCP servers, single tools and skills on and off

plugins.name: cache-control
plugins.description: Prompt-cache meter with cold-send cost, confirmation and keep-warm

plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: Plan usage windows with pace and a daily budget

plugins.name: context-meter
plugins.description: What fills the context window, with your own auto-compact threshold and summary style

plugins.name: mod-manager
plugins.description: /mods: turn mods, themes and plugins on and off, update and install them

plugins.name: package-manager
plugins.description: Detects each project's package manager (npm, pnpm, yarn or bun) and runs that one instead of whatever Claude typed

plugins.name: atelier
plugins.description: Quiet dot-dither looks on Claude's warm grays: two scenes in four tints, light and dark
